plugins.name: kabuken
plugins.description: Individual XBRL facts from Japanese statutory EDINET filings, with bilingual EN/JA labels, calculation trees, segment breakdowns, and provenance. Validated coverage: 99 of 99 TOPIX-100 constituents, 1,967 filings (measured 2026-09-21). Broader coverage in progress. No stock prices. Signup required.

headings: Step 3: Authenticate with an API key (fallback)
Step 4: Explain the tiers if asked

skills.name: peer-comparison

skills.description: Show the business-segment or geographic breakdown for a Japanese listed company's filing using Kabuken MCP tools.
